summary: Commonwealth model legislative provisions for money laundering and asset recovery, providing a modular framework for common law jurisdictions to align with FATF standards.

definitions_and_standards.beneficial_owner: The natural person who ultimately owns or controls a customer or exercises effective control over a legal person/arrangement.
definitions_and_standards.gatekeepers: Lawyers, accountants, real estate agents, and TCSPs acting as entry points to the financial system.
definitions_and_standards.currency: Includes virtual currency as a medium of exchange (reflecting 2016 update).
